reader_summary.overview: This week and next week we will break down the two biggest levers we have in the fight against climate change. Carbon reduction and carbon removal. Today, we will focus on carbon removal. To break down where we stand and what needs to be done, I’m joined by Nan Ransohoff.

key_points.text: Nan is Head of Climate at Stripe and she also leads Frontier.
We discuss the broad climate picture, the state of technology today.
Please enjoy this primer on Carbon Removal.
